name: Akitsu Minami
source:
She works as an elevator girl in a department store. She is married and gets along well with her husband. 

She is a motherly woman with an older sisterly personality. She views the main character as a cute junior, nicknaming him Ako.

She has a peculiar constitution, she starts to lactate when her pleasure levels rise.
